status.summary: Lost his first pro fight in his first UFC title shot: Alexander Volkanovski stopped him with punches from half guard at 4:54 of round 2 at UFC 333 (Abu Dhabi, Oct 24, 2026). He entered 20-0. He landed 3 of 4 takedowns in round 1 but turned them into only 31 seconds of control, then was stuffed on all three shots in round 2 and out-landed 32-20 before the finish. Before that he beat Lerone Murphy by majority decision (48-46, 48-46, 47-47) in a five-round main event in London (Mar 21, 2026) and Aljamain Sterling by UD (UFC 310, Dec 7, 2024). Still listed No. 1 at featherweight after UFC 333. No bout booked and no injury reported. Age 32.

style.summary: A wrestle-boxer who wins on takedown volume and control rather than damage: ten UFC wins, all on the scorecards, and no knockdowns scored. He boxes at range (88% of his landed significant strikes over three years came at distance) with a head-first mix that has added body punching, and his output and wrestling rise as the fight goes on. Volkanovski showed the counter: get up from the early takedowns, stuff the later ones and hit him as he resets.
